m: तट m. (exceptionally n., Daśar. ii, 18/19) a slope, declivity, any part of the body which has (as it were) sloping, sides (cf. श्रोणि-, स्तन-, &c.), a shore, MBh. (said of Śiva, xii, 10381), Hariv. &c. (ifc. f(ई). , Bhartṛ.)
तट cf. अ-, उत्-; पुर-तटी.
a: तटः — [तट्-अच्] 1 A slope, declivity, precipice. --2 The sky or horizon. --3 An epithet of Śiva. --टः --टा, --टी, --टं 1 The shore or bank, declivity, slope; शीलं शैलतटात्पततु Bh. 2. 39; प्रोत्तुंगचिंतातटी Bh. 3. 45; सिंधोस्तटावोघ इव प्रवृद्धः Ku. 3. 6; U. 3. 8; उच्चारणात्पक्षिगणास्तटीस्तं Śi. 4. 18. --2 A term applied to certain parts of the body which have, as it were, sloping sides; पद्मापयोधरतटीपरिरंभलग्न Gīt. 1; नो लुप्तं सखि चंदनं स्तनतटे Ś. Til. 7; so जघनतट, कटितट, श्रोणीतट, कुचतट, कंठतट, ललाटतट &c. --टं A field. --Comp. --आघातः butting, striking against a bank or declivity; अभ्यस्यंति तटाघातं निर्जितैरावता गजाः Ku. 2. 50. --स्थ a. {1} (lit.) situated on a bank or declivity. {2} (fig.) standing aloof, neutral, indifferent, alien, passive; तटस्थः स्वानर्थान् घटयति च मौनं च भजते Māl. 1. 14; तटस्थं नैराश्यात् U. 3. 13; मया तष्टस्थस्त्वमुपद्रुतोसि N. 3. 55 (where तटस्थ has sense 1. also). --(स्थः) an indifferent person, one neither a friend nor a foe. --(स्थं) that property or लक्षण of a thing which is distinct from its nature, and yet is the property by which it is known; e. g. गंधवत्त्व in the case of पृथ्वी.

k.v: चक्राणि पुटभेदाः स्युर्भ्रमाश्च जलनिर्गमाः। कूलं रोधश्च तीरं च प्रतीरं च तटं त्रिषु॥

s: klI, lakzaRaviSezaH । tasya svarUpaM yaTA, tadBinnatve sati tadboDakatvam । taTAca । “svarUpaM tawasTaM dbiDAlakzaRaM syAt svarUpasya boDo yato lakzaRAByAm । svarUpe pravizwAt svarUpe'pravizwAt yaTA kAkavanto gfhAH KaM vilaYca ॥” iti vedAntakArikA ॥ (tawe tizWatIti । sTA + kaH .) tawasTite, tri ॥ (udAsInaH । yaTA, nEzaDe । 3 । 55 । “Dik cApale vatsimavatsalatvaM yatpreraRAduttaralIBavantyA । samIrasaNgAdiva nIraBaNgyA mayA tawasTastvamupadruto'si ॥” samIpasTaH । yaTAha balaH । “tawasTaH syAdudAsIne tIrasTanikawasTayoH ॥”)
v: tri॰ tawe samIpe tizWati sTA--ka । 1 samIpasTe 2 vAdiprativAdiBAvAnApanne udAsIne ca “tawasTaH SaNkate” jAgadISyAdO BUriprayogaH । 3 lakzaRaviSeze yAvallakzyakAlamanavasTitatve sati itaravyAvarttake viSezaRe yaTA pfTivyA ganDavattvaM tawasTalakzaRam utpattikAle pralaye ca lakzyasTitAvapi tatkAle ganDasyAnavasTAnAt taTAtvam । yaTA vAM vrahmaRo jagatkarvftvAdikam tasya pralayAdO lakzyakAle anavasTAnAt taTAtvam । “svarUpaM tawasTaM dviDA lakzaRAByAm । svarUpe'pravizwAt svarUpe praMvizwAt । yaTA kAkavanto gfhAH KaM vilaYca” vedAntakA॰ । vedA॰ pa॰ asya vivftiryaTA “tatra lakzaRaM dviviDam svarUpalakzaRaM tawasTalakzaRaYceti । tatra svarUpameva lakzaRaM svarUpalakzaRam yaTA satyaM jYAnamanantaM brahmaRaH svarUpalakzaRam । nanu svasya svavfttitvABAvena kaTaM lakzaRatvamiti cenna svasyEva svApekzayA DarmaDarmiBAvakalpanayA lakzaRatvasamBavAt । taduktaM vivaraRe “Anando vizayAnuBavo nityatvaYceti santi DarmAH apfTaktve'pi cEtanyAt pfTagivAvaBAsante iti” । tawasTalakzaRaM nAma yAvallakzyakAlamanavasTitatve sati yadvyAvarttakaM tadeva yaTA ganDavattvaM pfTivIlakzaRam । mahApralaye paramARuzu utpattikAle GawAdizu ca ganDABAvAt । prakfte ca jagajjanmAdikAraRatvam । atra jagatpadena kAryyajAtaM vivakzitam । kAraRatvaYca karttftvam ato'vidyAdO nAtivyAptiH । kartftvaYca tattadupAdAnagocarAparokzajYAnacikIrzAkftimattvam । ISvarasya tAbadupAdAnagocarAparokzajYAnasadBAve ca “yaH sarvajYaH sarvavit yasya jYAnamayaM tapaH । tasmAdetadbrahma nAma rUpamannaYca jAyate” ityAdiSrutirmAnam । tAdfSacikIrzAsadBAve ca “so'kAmayata bahusyAM prajAyeyeti” SrutirmAnam । tAdfSakftO ca “tanmano'kurutetyAdi” vAkyam । jYAnecCAkftInAmanyatamagarBaM lakzaRatritayaM vivakzitam anyaTA vyarTaviSezaRatvApatteH । ataeva janmasTitiDvaMsAnAmanyatamasyEva lakzarRa praveSaH । evaYca lakzaRAni nava sampadyante । brahmaRo jagajjanmAdikAraRatve ca “yato vA imAni BUtAni jAyante yena jAtAni jIvanti, yat prayantyaBisaMviSantItyAdi” SrutirmAnam । yadvA niKilajagadupAdAnatvaM vrahmaRo lakzaRam । upAdAnatvaYca jagadaDyAsADizWAnatvaM jagadAkAreRa pariRamamAnamAyADizWAnatvaM vA । etAdfSamevopAdAnatvamaBipretya “idaM sarvaM yadayamAtmA saccAsaccABavat bahu syAM prajAyeyetyAdi Srutizu vrahmaprapaYcayostAdAtmyavyapadeSaH” tawasTite tri॰ ।
